LanguageData.FB_DeepMawTrap.label: deep maw trap
LanguageData.FB_DeepMawTrap.description: A mouth hidden beneath flesh that reacts to enemies. After a short delay, it swallows every creature in its 2×2 area, including allies. Organic victims are digested into hemogel; mechanoids are ground down and their remains expelled.
LanguageData.FB_DeepMawTrapEmbryo.label: deep maw trap embryo
LanguageData.FB_DeepMawTrapEmbryo.description: An immature trap organ that will grow into a deep maw trap.
